entities.name: Java
about: Java is a general-purpose, object-oriented programming language known for its 'write once, run anywhere' philosophy: code compiles to bytecode that runs on any machine with a JVM. ☕
Java is a statically typed, class-based language released by Sun Microsystems in 1995. It is widely used for enterprise systems, Android apps, and large backend services.
Java is one of the world's most widely used programming languages, valued for its portability, strong typing, and huge ecosystem of libraries.
creatorFact: James Gosling created Java in 1995 while working at Sun Microsystems.
Java was created by James Gosling at Sun Microsystems in the mid-1990s.
James Gosling is widely known as the father of Java, having designed the original language and compiler at Sun Microsystems.
advantages: Java has several advantages: platform independence (Write Once, Run Anywhere via the JVM), strong static type safety, automatic garbage collection, and robust enterprise scalability.
Key advantages of Java include cross-platform portability, high performance with modern JIT compilers, extensive libraries, and strong multithreading support.
Java offers major advantages: write once run anywhere, strong memory management, exceptional backward compatibility, and an enormous ecosystem.

entities.name: Python
about: Python is a versatile, high-level programming language known for its clear syntax and readability. It is widely used in data science, artificial intelligence, and web development.
Python is an interpreted, general-purpose programming language designed with an emphasis on code readability and simplicity.
Python is one of the world's most popular programming languages, powering everything from machine learning models to web servers.
creatorFact: Python was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.
Guido van Rossum created Python in the late 1980s as a successor to the ABC language, officially releasing it in 1991.
Guido van Rossum is the creator and original Benevolent Dictator For Life (BDFL) of Python.
advantages: Python has several advantages: clear, readable syntax that accelerates development, an enormous library ecosystem, dynamic typing, and industry dominance in AI and data science.
Python's advantages include simplicity, high developer productivity, cross-platform portability, and powerful frameworks for machine learning and web development.
Key advantages of Python: easy to learn and read, versatile for scripting and large projects, and unmatched support for artificial intelligence.

entities.name: JavaScript
about: JavaScript is the programming language of the web: it runs in every browser to make pages interactive, and on servers through Node.js.
creatorFact: JavaScript was created by Brendan Eich at Netscape in 1995.
advantages: JavaScript's advantages: it runs everywhere a browser does, has a huge package ecosystem (npm), and lets one language cover both front end and back end.

entities.name: TypeScript
about: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript that adds static types and compiles down to plain JavaScript.
creatorFact: TypeScript was created at Microsoft, led by Anders Hejlsberg, and first released in 2012.
advantages: TypeScript's advantages: type checking catches many bugs before the code runs, editors can offer better autocomplete and refactoring, and it works with existing JavaScript code.

entities.name: C
about: C is a low-level, compiled programming language that gives direct control over memory. Operating systems such as Unix and Linux are written in it.
creatorFact: C was created by Dennis Ritchie at Bell Labs in the early 1970s.
advantages: C's advantages: it is very fast, runs on almost any hardware, and gives precise control over memory, which is why it is used for operating systems and embedded devices.

entities.name: C++
about: C++ is a compiled language that extends C with classes, templates and other high-level features while keeping low-level control.
creatorFact: C++ was created by Bjarne Stroustrup at Bell Labs, starting in 1979 as 'C with Classes'; it was named C++ in 1983.
advantages: C++'s advantages: high performance, fine control over memory and hardware, and powerful abstractions, which make it popular for games, browsers and trading systems.

entities.name: C#
about: C# is a modern, object-oriented language from Microsoft that runs on the .NET platform. It is used for desktop apps, web services, and games built with Unity.
creatorFact: C# was designed at Microsoft by a team led by Anders Hejlsberg and released in 2000.
advantages: C#'s advantages: a clean, strongly typed syntax, excellent tooling, automatic memory management, and a large standard library through .NET.

entities.name: Go
about: Go is a compiled language from Google designed for simplicity and for building fast, concurrent network services.
creatorFact: Go was designed at Google by Robert Griesemer, Rob Pike and Ken Thompson, and released publicly in 2009.
advantages: Go's advantages: a small, easy-to-learn syntax, very fast compilation, built-in concurrency with goroutines, and single-file binaries that are simple to deploy.

entities.name: Rust
about: Rust is a systems programming language focused on memory safety and performance, without needing a garbage collector.
creatorFact: Rust was started by Graydon Hoare in 2006 and sponsored by Mozilla; version 1.0 was released in 2015.
advantages: Rust's advantages: its compiler prevents whole classes of memory bugs and data races, it is as fast as C and C++, and it has modern tooling through Cargo.

entities.name: Kotlin
about: Kotlin is a modern, statically typed language that runs on the JVM and is the preferred language for Android development.
creatorFact: Kotlin was created by JetBrains, the company behind IntelliJ IDEA, and first announced in 2011.
advantages: Kotlin's advantages: concise syntax, built-in null safety, full interoperability with Java code, and first-class support for Android.

entities.name: Swift
about: Swift is Apple's programming language for building apps on iOS, macOS, watchOS and tvOS.
creatorFact: Swift was created at Apple, led by Chris Lattner, and introduced in 2014.
advantages: Swift's advantages: safe and readable syntax, strong performance, and tight integration with Apple's platforms and tools.

entities.name: Ruby
about: Ruby is a dynamic, object-oriented language designed to be pleasant to write. It is best known for the Ruby on Rails web framework.
creatorFact: Ruby was created by Yukihiro 'Matz' Matsumoto in Japan and first released in 1995.
advantages: Ruby's advantages: expressive, readable syntax, high developer productivity, and a mature web framework in Ruby on Rails.

entities.name: PHP
about: PHP is a scripting language made for web development. It powers a large share of websites, including those built on WordPress.
creatorFact: PHP was created by Rasmus Lerdorf, who released the first version in 1995.
advantages: PHP's advantages: it is easy to deploy on almost any web host, simple to get started with, and backed by a large ecosystem of frameworks such as Laravel.

entities.name: Scala
about: Scala is a JVM language that combines object-oriented and functional programming. It is widely used for data processing with Apache Spark.
creatorFact: Scala was created by Martin Odersky at EPFL in Switzerland and first released in 2004.
advantages: Scala's advantages: a powerful type system, concise functional style, and full access to Java libraries.

entities.name: Perl
about: Perl is a scripting language known for its strength in text processing and system administration.
creatorFact: Perl was created by Larry Wall and first released in 1987.
advantages: Perl's advantages: excellent regular-expression support, a huge module archive (CPAN), and quick scripting for text and system tasks.

entities.name: R
about: R is a programming language built for statistics and data visualization, widely used by statisticians and data analysts.
creatorFact: R was created by Ross Ihaka and Robert Gentleman at the University of Auckland in the early 1990s.
advantages: R's advantages: thousands of statistics packages, excellent plotting libraries such as ggplot2, and a strong research community.

entities.name: SQL
about: SQL (Structured Query Language) is the standard language for storing, querying and updating data in relational databases.
creatorFact: SQL was developed at IBM in the early 1970s by Donald Chamberlin and Raymond Boyce.
advantages: SQL's advantages: it is declarative (you say what data you want, not how to fetch it), standardized across databases, and very good at combining and summarizing large tables.

entities.name: HTML
about: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the markup language that defines the structure and content of web pages.
creatorFact: HTML was created by Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, in the early 1990s.
advantages: HTML's advantages: it is simple to learn, supported by every browser, and the foundation that every website is built on.

entities.name: CSS
about: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is the language that controls how web pages look: layout, colors, fonts and animations.
creatorFact: CSS was first proposed by Håkon Wium Lie in 1994 and became a W3C standard in 1996.
advantages: CSS's advantages: it separates design from content, lets one stylesheet restyle a whole site, and adapts pages to different screen sizes.
